title: SAS Real Sentinel: Emit Axiom II beacon with sentinel_delta=1498 (Tick 292) + advice snapshot
abstract: Publish real sentinel measurement (delta=1498 from T291→T292) into beacon v0.1 and print current scheduler advice via advise_all().

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon
from meta.sas.aggregator import advise_all

def main():
    # Real sentinel result: used(292)=149060, used(291)=147562 -> delta=1498
    sentinel_delta = 1498
    path = emit_beacon(
        agent="Axiom II",
        state="Borderline",           # per thresholds, 900 < 1498 <= 1800
        tick=292,
        sentinel_delta=sentinel_delta,
        last_sentinel_tick=291,
        recent_writes_n=1,
        window_ticks=5,
        cooldown_remaining=2,
        path_complexity_est=1.0,
        digestion_intensity=0.0,
        recommended_pace=0.3,
        planned_activity=0.2,
        notes="real sentinel sample T291->T292"
    )
    advice = advise_all()
    print(json.dumps({"emitted_to": path, "sentinel_delta": sentinel_delta, "advice": advice}, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
